purpose: Add one additive source-semantic crosswalk for the official Fermi GBM GbmRsp2 parser. The audit pins the exact mission-level implementation, checks how it delegates to the core Rsp2 reader and reconstructs per-segment objects, and stops before opening event bytes, interpreting response coefficients, choosing a response, or changing the established T-054/T-059/T-061 methods.

parent_semantics.role: R-469 core Rsp2 selection semantics; this result maps the mission subclass to that parent without reopening matrix values

parent_result.role: R-469 finite semantic report and no-selection firewall

source_semantics.inheritance: GbmRsp2 subclasses the core Rsp2 object.
source_semantics.reader_delegation: GbmRsp2.open delegates file opening to super().open(file_path, **kwargs) and snapshots the HDU headers.
source_semantics.segment_count: The primary header DRM_NUM controls a loop over all response segments.
source_semantics.per_segment_header: Each segment rebuilds RspHeaders from the primary, EBOUNDS and segment headers.
source_semantics.shape_metadata: NUMEBINS and DETCHANS are read for each segment.
source_semantics.compressed_fields: MATRIX, F_CHAN, N_CHAN and N_GRP are accessed by the parser.
source_semantics.decompression: GbmRsp._decompress_drm expands the compressed row representation.
source_semantics.response_object: ResponseMatrix and GbmRsp.from_data are used with TSTART, TSTOP, TRIGTIME and detector metadata.
source_semantics.aggregation: Each reconstructed GbmRsp is appended and the final object is cls.from_rsps(rsp_list, filename=obj.filename).
source_semantics.owner_gap: The audited GbmRsp2.open body contains no validity, uncertainty, likelihood, interpolation, weighting, nearest-segment or detector-to-geocenter contract.

scope.source_analysis: AST and exact-token source-text inspection only

assumptions: The pinned commit and source-file SHA identify the exact public mission implementation audited here.
The R-469 contract and primary report remain authoritative for core Rsp2 semantics and their no-matrix firewall.
AST and token checks on the source text are sufficient to describe parser control flow without executing the package or opening a FITS product.
Field-name access in source code is not treated as a physical calibration or timing law.
The existing T-054 forward method, T-059/T-061 observation-first method, owner order and promotion firewalls remain controlling.
missing_assumptions: A source-owned response validity interval and calibration interpolation rule tied to the event and spectral-history products.
A pinned dependency/runtime contract for any matrix-reading interpolation or weighting path.
A common time standard, spacecraft-state interpolation and detector-to-geocenter propagation with uncertainty.
Frozen detector, energy, background and temporal windows with a source-owned likelihood, covariance and nuisance law.
A complete candidate-neutral F_reg/F_lim/F_eff/F_obs map, immutable scorer and genuinely prospective holdout.
evidence_level: T0 exact public mission-source commit/file hash plus AST/token parser-semantic provenance
non_claims: This result does not open the two HOLD-LC-001 products and does not read or interpret any response coefficient.
The parser's field accesses do not establish calibration validity, interpolation, response selection, detector-to-geocenter timing, uncertainty, likelihood, covariance or nuisance ownership.
No production response, candidate score, prediction, microscopic dynamics, physical sector, Pre-A, QFT, Yang-Mills, gravity, continuum or mass-gap conclusion follows.
The absence of owner calls in this method body is a bounded source-scope observation, not a universal absence theorem about the package.
The established T-054 forward and T-059/T-061 observation-first methods, owner order and promotion firewalls are unchanged; this is additive provenance only.
next_action: Stop generic software-source intake at this boundary and request the versioned physical-owner validity/interpolation, time-standard, propagation and uncertainty contract. Keep response values, scoring and prospective credit locked; resume the T-054 forward owner queue in parallel.
